# MyTempMails

> Free disposable temporary email service providing instant anonymous inboxes, real-time OTP receipt, and multi-provider auto-failover.

## Core Features

- [Temporary Mailbox](https://tempmail.mytempmails.com/): Instant disposable email generator with live auto-refresh inbox and 10-minute timer.
- [Why Disposable Mail](https://tempmail.mytempmails.com/#why-temp-mail): Protection against phishing, commercial spam lists, and data brokers.
- [Feature Comparison](https://tempmail.mytempmails.com/#comparison): Comparison matrix against traditional webmail and basic burner tools.
- [FAQ](https://tempmail.mytempmails.com/#faq-section): Frequently asked questions on security, custom handles, and attachment support.

## Supported Engines

- Guerrilla Mail: Fast session-based disposable engine with zero registration overhead.
- Temp-Mail.io: High-speed engine with fresh domains.
- Mail.tm: Modern REST API with strict privacy controls.
- Inboxes (GetNada): Multi-domain disposable inboxes.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://mytempmails.com/privacy-policy/): 100% anonymous, zero personal data logged or retained.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://mytempmails.com/terms-and-conditions/): Usage rules and terms of service.
